'''Pierre's Missing Stocklist''' lets [[Pierre]] sell seeds from all seasons year-round in [[Pierre's General Store|his shop]]. It can be purchased from [[Qi's Walnut Room]] for {{Price|50|gem}}.

Seeds sold out-of-season cost 50% more than they would if in-season.  The price of Pierre's [[Pierre's General Store#Year-Round Stock|year-round stock]] is unaffected.

The stocklist needs to be delivered to Pierre to work. Trying to give it to anyone other than Pierre displays a message "[Villager] looks puzzled..." The new inventory items become available for purchase immediately after giving Pierre the stocklist.

==Notes==
*Pierre's Missing Stocklist does not unlock year 1 access to seeds normally sold only in year 2+ (''i.e.,'' [[Garlic Seeds]], [[Red Cabbage Seeds]], and [[Artichoke Seeds]]). However, it allows the purchase of all year 2 seeds starting Spring 1 of year 2. 
**The Stocklist does not unlock [[Strawberry Seeds]], which must be purchased at the [[Egg Festival]] or the [[Desert Festival]].
**In multiplayer, if one player buys the stocklist, every player will be able to buy seeds from other seasons.
